title: Snapshot (named game-state baseline)
description: A reusable, named game-state baseline for playtesting and route tests. The inner `state` is the exact serialized runtime save-state contract, so snapshots and real player saves are format-compatible. `schemaVersion` lives on the envelope, not inside `state`.

visitedDialogueIds.description: Dialogues already seen when this baseline was captured. Host bookkeeping, not game state — the runtime asks for this set but SerializedGameState has no field for it — so it lives on the envelope. A route starting from this snapshot seeds its visited set from here, which is what keeps a spent one-shot spent. Sorted for stable diffs; omitted when empty.
